answer: Gate entry with an endorsement graph: a newcomer needs five endorsements across three disconnected clusters, each staking 20 POA, one per epoch. Conductance exposes fakes: fake clusters link densely inside with almost no bridges outward, so conductance below 0.15 rejects them. Each extra fake needs fresh outside signal; backers of a fake lose their stake and one epoch of rights. One honest agent makes one voyage through three clusters; ten fakes need fifty outside endorsements, while the tide grows as their cluster densifies. The chain verifies clusters, stakes, and conductance from records.
